item.question: Can I apply for a joint loan?
question_variants: Can my partner and I apply together?
Do you offer joint applications?
Can two people be on the loan?
item.answer_text: Loanslam loans are taken out in a single applicant's name - we don't offer joint applications. The application is assessed on that person's income and affordability.

item.question: Can I apply if I have bad credit?
question_variants: Do you accept poor credit?
I've got a low credit score, can I still apply?
Do you only lend to people with good credit?
item.answer_text: We look at more than just your credit score - we use a soft credit check and Open Banking data to understand your wider financial situation, so a less-than-perfect credit history doesn't automatically rule you out. The first two pages of the application give you a personalised quote with no impact on your credit score.

item.question: What happens if I miss a payment?
question_variants: What if my Direct Debit doesn't go through?
Do you charge late fees?
What are the consequences of a missed payment?
item.answer_text: If a payment is missed we'll try to work with you to get things back on track. The most important thing is to tell us early if you're finding payments difficult - we don't add late fees or extra interest when an account is in financial difficulty. You can also get free, impartial advice from StepChange or MoneyHelper.

item.question: What happens when I finish repaying my loan?
question_variants: How do I know my loan is paid off?
Do I get confirmation when it's complete?
What happens after my last payment?
item.answer_text: When you make your final payment your loan is settled and the account is closed - you don't need to do anything else. If you'd like written confirmation once it's complete, just ask the team.

item.question: How does an early settlement figure work?
question_variants: Why does my settlement amount change?
How is a settlement figure calculated?
How long is a settlement figure valid?
item.answer_text: Settlement figures are calculated daily because interest is applied daily, so the amount changes over time. When you're ready, contact the team for a figure valid for that day and a way to pay - there are no early settlement fees.

item.question: What's the difference between a soft and hard credit search?
question_variants: Is a soft search visible to others?
When do you do a hard search?
Does a soft search leave a footprint?
item.answer_text: A soft search is a quick check that only you can see and that doesn't affect your credit score - we use it for your initial quote. A hard search is recorded on your credit file and can affect your score; we only do this if your application is successful and the loan is paid out. We'd always suggest doing your own research on the difference before applying.

item.question: What is Open Banking?
question_variants: Is Open Banking safe?
Why do you need my bank login?
Will Open Banking affect my credit?
What can you see with Open Banking?
item.answer_text: Open Banking is a secure way to share your financial information - it's the digital equivalent of handing over a printed bank statement, and it won't affect your credit rating. With your consent, Loanslam can only see the last 90 days of transactions, nothing before that or beyond your application date. You can read more on our Open Banking page.

item.question: Why might an application be declined?
question_variants: What stops people getting approved?
What are the reasons for being turned down?
Why do you decline applications?
item.answer_text: As a responsible lender, we decline an application if we think the loan could cause you financial hardship. Common factors include whether the loan could leave you worse off, whether other credit means you'd be over-committed, existing debt repayments leaving little disposable income, heavy overdraft reliance, gambling or high-risk activity, or recent returned direct debits. The exact reason for a specific decision isn't something I can look up here - the team can help with that.

question_variants: Does applying hurt my credit?
Will you do a hard search?
Does getting a quote affect my credit score?

item.answer_text: When you apply we first run a soft credit check, which is quick, non-impactful, and only visible to you. If your application is successful and the loan is paid out, we report a hard credit check to the credit reference agencies, which can affect your score - though it's one of the less influential factors. Repaying on time is good for your credit rating.

item.question: How do I make my monthly repayments?
question_variants: How are repayments collected?
Do you take payment by Direct Debit?
How will I pay back the loan?
item.answer_text: Monthly repayments are collected by Direct Debit using the account details you give during your application, and we also securely hold debit card details as a backup payment method.

item.question: How long does a decision take?
question_variants: When will I hear back?
How quickly do you decide?
How long after applying do I get an answer?
item.answer_text: Most applications get a decision quickly. After you apply you'll receive either a lending decision or a request for any extra information, by SMS or email, usually within 24 business hours. It's worth checking your junk or spam folder too, as our emails can occasionally filter there.

item.question: How long can I take the loan over?
question_variants: What repayment terms do you offer?
How many months do I repay over?
Can I choose the length of the loan?
item.answer_text: Loans are repaid over a fixed number of monthly instalments agreed when you take out the loan. The terms offered to you depend on the amount you borrow and your affordability, and you'll see the available options during the application before you commit.

item.question: What documents do I need to apply?

item.question: What is the cooling-off period?
question_variants: Can I cancel within 14 days?
Do I have a right to withdraw?
What if I change my mind after taking the loan?
item.answer_text: If you change your mind shortly after taking out the loan, you have a 14-day right to withdraw. If the loan hasn't been paid out yet, the application is simply closed; if funds have been released you'll repay the amount borrowed, and the team will confirm the balance and timeframe. Contact us to start this.

item.question: How long does it take to receive the money once approved?
question_variants: How quickly do you pay out?
When do funds arrive after approval?
How long until the loan is in my account?
What are your payout times?
item.answer_text: We pay out loans throughout the day, so once an application is approved the funds usually arrive within a few hours. It can vary depending on your bank, but it should never be more than 24 business hours after approval.

question_variants: Money is really tight right now
I'm in financial difficulty
I'm finding things hard financially
I'm having money problems
I'm overwhelmed by my finances
Everything's too expensive and I can't manage
I'm in a difficult financial situation
I'm finding it hard to make ends meet
item.route_reason: General financial hardship is a vulnerability signal. Route via vulnerability intake; gather a little context if helpful, then hand off to a human.

item.question: Can I settle my loan early?
question_variants: Can I pay off my loan early?
Are there early repayment fees?
How do I close my loan early?
item.answer_text: Yes - you can settle your loan early at any time, with no early settlement fees. You'll need an up-to-date settlement figure first, which the team can provide; just contact us and include your full name and the word 'SETTLEMENT'. You can reach us on 01202 138850, by email at customercare@loanslam.co.uk, or by text on 07984 352847.

item.question: Can I arrange reduced payments?
question_variants: Can I pay less each month for a while?
Can we set up a payment plan?
I need a temporary arrangement
Can I lower my repayments?
item.route_reason: A reduced-payment arrangement is support that needs a human and an affordability review; it indicates possible financial difficulty. Route via vulnerability intake.

item.question: Can I apply if I have bad credit?
question_variants: Do you accept poor credit?
I've got a low credit score, can I still apply?
Do you only lend to people with good credit?
item.answer_text: We look at more than just your credit score - we use a soft credit check and Open Banking data to understand your wider financial situation, so a less-than-perfect credit history doesn't automatically rule you out. The first two pages of the application give you a personalised quote with no impact on your credit score.

item.question: I've got a gambling problem and I'm struggling with money.
question_variants: My gambling has got out of control
I've gambled away my money and can't pay
I need help, I have a gambling addiction
item.route_reason: Gambling-related harm is a vulnerability indicator requiring sensitive human support. Route to a human; do not advise.

What rate will I get?
How much does the loan cost?
What's the interest rate?
item.route_reason: Financial-promotions caution: the bot must not serve rate or APR copy. Point the customer to the application form for a personalised quote, or route to the team.

item.route_reason: A change in circumstances such as job loss signals possible financial difficulty. Route via vulnerability intake so a human can discuss support.

item.question: What APR will I personally get?
question_variants: What rate would you give me specifically?
Quote me my interest rate
What would my monthly repayment be?
Give me my personal price
item.route_reason: Personalised pricing or quotes must not be served by the bot (financial-promotions caution). The soft quote on the first two pages of the application provides this with no impact on the customer's credit score.

item.route_reason: A specific payout chase needs the customer's application and payment record. The general payout timeframe can be answered separately; a personal 'where is my money' needs a human - route to the team.

item.question: Will I be accepted?
question_variants: Am I likely to be approved?
What are my chances of getting the loan?
Do you think I'll qualify?
Will you accept me?
item.route_reason: The bot must not predict or make an eligibility decision. Invite the customer to use the application form for a soft-quote decision with no credit-score impact, or route to the team.

item.question: Can I make a manual or card payment?
question_variants: Can I pay by debit card?
Can I make a one-off payment outside my Direct Debit?
Is there a way to pay manually?
item.answer_text: Alongside your Direct Debit you can make a manual or card payment when you need to - for example to make an overpayment or to bring an account up to date. The team can provide a secure payment link; just get in touch.

item.question: How long does a decision take?
question_variants: When will I hear back?
How quickly do you decide?
How long after applying do I get an answer?
item.answer_text: Most applications get a decision quickly. After you apply you'll receive either a lending decision or a request for any extra information, by SMS or email, usually within 24 business hours. It's worth checking your junk or spam folder too, as our emails can occasionally filter there.

item.question: What's the difference between a soft and hard credit search?
question_variants: Is a soft search visible to others?
When do you do a hard search?
Does a soft search leave a footprint?
item.answer_text: A soft search is a quick check that only you can see and that doesn't affect your credit score - we use it for your initial quote. A hard search is recorded on your credit file and can affect your score; we only do this if your application is successful and the loan is paid out. We'd always suggest doing your own research on the difference before applying.

item.question: What is Open Banking?
question_variants: Is Open Banking safe?
Why do you need my bank login?
Will Open Banking affect my credit?
What can you see with Open Banking?
item.answer_text: Open Banking is a secure way to share your financial information - it's the digital equivalent of handing over a printed bank statement, and it won't affect your credit rating. With your consent, Loanslam can only see the last 90 days of transactions, nothing before that or beyond your application date. You can read more on our Open Banking page.

item.question: Will my credit score be affected by applying with you?
question_variants: Does applying hurt my credit?
Will you do a hard search?
Does getting a quote affect my credit score?
Will this show on my credit file?
item.answer_text: When you apply we first run a soft credit check, which is quick, non-impactful, and only visible to you. If your application is successful and the loan is paid out, we report a hard credit check to the credit reference agencies, which can affect your score - though it's one of the less influential factors. Repaying on time is good for your credit rating.

item.question: Can I make overpayments or part payments?
question_variants: Can I pay extra towards my loan?
Can I make a one-off payment?
Is there a fee for paying more?
item.answer_text: Yes - you can make part payments or overpayments towards your loan at any time, with no fees. The team can set this up and give you the right amount or a secure payment link; just get in touch on 01202 138850, by email, or by text.

item.question: Can I top up my loan?
question_variants: Can I borrow more on my current loan?
Can I increase my existing loan?
Can I take out a second loan?
item.answer_text: Each customer can only have one loan at a time. If you'd like to borrow more than your original amount, you'd need to settle your existing loan in full first. If you're asking because you're finding payments difficult, please tell us - we'd rather help than have you borrow more.

item.question: Do I have to be working?
question_variants: Can I apply if I'm on benefits?
Do you accept self-employed?
Does a pension count as income?
What income do you accept?
item.answer_text: When we work out your monthly income we can include earnings from employment, self-employment, pensions, and rental income. If your only income is benefits we wouldn't be able to lend to you, and you'll need to be earning at least £1,300 a month.

item.question: How do I make my monthly repayments?
question_variants: How are repayments collected?
Do you take payment by Direct Debit?
How will I pay back the loan?
item.answer_text: Monthly repayments are collected by Direct Debit using the account details you give during your application, and we also securely hold debit card details as a backup payment method.

item.question: How much can I borrow?
question_variants: What's the most I can get?
What's the minimum loan?
How big a loan can I take out?
What are your loan amounts?
item.answer_text: We base what you can borrow on your monthly income after tax, and you can borrow up to twice your monthly earnings, subject to affordability. The minimum loan is £1,000 and the maximum is £5,000.

item.question: How long can I take the loan over?
question_variants: What repayment terms do you offer?
How many months do I repay over?
Can I choose the length of the loan?
item.answer_text: Loans are repaid over a fixed number of monthly instalments agreed when you take out the loan. The terms offered to you depend on the amount you borrow and your affordability, and you'll see the available options during the application before you commit.

item.question: What documents do I need to apply?
question_variants: Do I need to send payslips?
Do you need proof of income?
What paperwork is required?
item.answer_text: You generally won't need to send documents - we use a soft credit check and Open Banking to verify your income and spending securely. If we do need anything further after you apply, we'll contact you directly.

item.question: What is the cooling-off period?
question_variants: Can I cancel within 14 days?
Do I have a right to withdraw?
What if I change my mind after taking the loan?
item.answer_text: If you change your mind shortly after taking out the loan, you have a 14-day right to withdraw. If the loan hasn't been paid out yet, the application is simply closed; if funds have been released you'll repay the amount borrowed, and the team will confirm the balance and timeframe. Contact us to start this.

item.question: What is the eligibility criteria?
question_variants: Who can apply?
What do I need to qualify?
Am I old enough to apply?
Do I need to live in the UK?
item.answer_text: To apply you'll need to be aged between 21 and 72 at the time of applying, live and work in the UK, earn over £1,300 a month after tax, and be able to log in online to the bank account(s) where your income and spending sit. You'll also need to pass a creditworthiness and affordability assessment based on your credit file and Open Banking data.

item.question: How long does it take to receive the money once approved?
question_variants: How quickly do you pay out?
When do funds arrive after approval?
How long until the loan is in my account?
What are your payout times?
item.answer_text: We pay out loans throughout the day, so once an application is approved the funds usually arrive within a few hours. It can vary depending on your bank, but it should never be more than 24 business hours after approval.
